Oh man, it's been too long since I've done a pure monstergirl (non-fox) translation like this. I really had fun with this one. That said, the editing took forever because of the transparent bubbles, so that's why it's been a minute since my last release. Yeah, I did do the RAITA one simultaneously as well, but still. Feels like the artist got irritated by the end too, because he goes from just floating text, no stroke at all, to stroking it, to just saying "fuck it" and using pure white, non-transparent bubbles by the end. Anyway, it was worth it for this one. The ogre/orc girl was hot, the shota was funny, the story was simple but made sense, etc.

Happy fapping!
